info.title: EPA fueleconomy.gov bulk data (yorishiro kami spec)
info.description: Hand-authored OpenAPI 3 spec for the EPA's public fueleconomy.gov bulk CSV download. Single op; the response is a multi-megabyte CSV body. Reference: https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/download.shtml

get.summary: Download the full EPA vehicles dataset as CSV
get.description: GETs the canonical EPA vehicle fuel economy CSV. Body is returned verbatim — the caller cell parses it via stdlib csv. Multi-megabyte payload (~40 MB at time of authoring); set caller timeouts accordingly.

schema.description: RFC-4180 CSV body. Headers include modelId, make, model, year, city08, highway08, comb08, …
